<function=python>
<parameter=code>
action(['RIGHT'], intent='explore')
def snap(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','W','b','c','G','g'):
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'], min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)))
    return out
print('after RIGHT:', snap(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
